title: Science becomes trustworthy by constantly questioning itself
content:
by Brian A. Nosek

What happens when the greatest strengths of science—openness, humility, self-criticism, and self-correction—are exploited for political gain? Scientists affirm the genuine application of those strengths as the source of its trustworthiness. What happens when the greatest strengths of science, such as openness, humility, self-criticism and self-correction, are exploited for political gain? This Perspective calls for scientists to affirm the genuine application of those strengths as the source of its trustworthiness.
author: Brian A. Nosek
